Roll Guile to spread smoke for heavy cover or ice for difficult terrain. Sustain the area with a Maneuver each turn.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self when a visible creature within 2 squares moves past actual concealment.
Type
Skill / Movement / Utility

After the creature finishes moving, move up to your Speed toward the concealment without provoking. If your endpoint offers actual concealment, attempt to Hide there with 1 Boon as part of this Reaction.
